planets.name: XO-3 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of XO-3 with a 3.19-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: XO-3 b was found in 2007 by XO as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around XO-3. Its orbit and size follow Rusznak et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname RUSZNAK_ET_AL_2025): disc_year 2007, disc_facility XO, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.19152255771, pl_radj 1.32, pl_bmassj 13.27

quotes.title: XO-3b
quotes.card: XO-3b is an exoplanet with about 11.79 times the mass of Jupiter, and it orbits its parent star XO-3 in about 3.2 days.
quotes.introduction: The radius of this object is 1.217 times that of Jupiter.

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 4.5 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
